title: Hyperposition H1 Monotonicity-Gated Runtime
summary: Open architecture candidate: preserve contextual/n-ary/bitemporal semantics in canonical state, compile dynamic assemblies incrementally, classify transitions by monotonicity, and synchronize only non-monotone conflict domains and external effects while treating zero-copy as a locality optimization rather than semantic authority.
open_questions: Does the monotonicity classifier predict which live FRANK transitions can safely remain coordination-free?
Which equal-semantics backend wins on revocation, recovery and latency?
Does q95/q99 change amplification predict real FRANK latency/recovery failures better than mean R_delta?
Where is the measured crossover between incremental maintenance and rebuild?
What is the cache-coherence and recovery cost of shared-memory IPC on FRANK target hardware?
